configSchema.title: Anthropic
configSchema.description: Connect an Anthropic API key so Claude-powered agents and workflows can run. The key is stored securely via the connection service.

fields.label: API key storage
fields.whenReady: API keys are stored securely via the connection service.
fields.whenNotReady: Configure the connection service first so Anthropic API requests can authenticate.

fields.label: Connection
fields.description: Check whether an Anthropic API key is configured.

fields.label: Anthropic API key
fields.description: Create a key at console.anthropic.com. Write-only — the stored value is never shown again.

fields.label: Default model
fields.description: The default Claude model agents use unless an agent overrides it.

variants.name: skillsUnavailable
variants.message: Skills settings are not available on this host version yet — update the host to manage Anthropic skill upload here.

fields.label: Data residency — not ZDR-eligible
fields.whenReady: Anthropic Custom Skills are not ZDR-eligible. Enabling this uploads skill bodies and their bundled directories off this instance to Anthropic Custom Skills (workspace / API-key-wide), where Anthropic retains them. Only skills explicitly allowed per skill are uploaded; all others stay local even when this is on.
fields.whenNotReady: Skills settings are not available on this host version yet. Update the host to manage Anthropic skill upload here.

fields.label: Upload skill content to Anthropic
fields.description: Sync catalog skills to Anthropic Custom Skills so Anthropic-pinned agents can use them. Default off. Individual skills are excluded unless explicitly allowed per skill.

fields.label: Connect Anthropic
fields.whenReady: Create an API key at console.anthropic.com, paste it into the Anthropic API key field on the Setup tab, and save. Pick a default Claude model on the Setup tab — agents use it unless they override it.
fields.whenNotReady: Create an API key at console.anthropic.com, paste it into the Anthropic API key field on the Setup tab, and save. Pick a default Claude model on the Setup tab — agents use it unless they override it.

fields.label: About Skills upload
fields.whenReady: The Skills tab lets Anthropic-pinned agents use your catalog skills. Anthropic Custom Skills are not ZDR-eligible: enabling upload sends skill bodies and their bundled directories to Anthropic, where they are retained. Only skills explicitly allowed per skill are uploaded.
fields.whenNotReady: The Skills tab lets Anthropic-pinned agents use your catalog skills. Anthropic Custom Skills are not ZDR-eligible: enabling upload sends skill bodies and their bundled directories to Anthropic, where they are retained. Only skills explicitly allowed per skill are uploaded.
